title: Kavi multilingual foundations: a prerequisite graph, not a randomized reading list
purpose: Define the order in which Kavi could acquire script, number, language, and original-source skills without treating one region, language, or translation as the default.
ordering_rule: A node may begin only after every listed prerequisite has passed its own protected and held-out checks. Nodes at the same level are independent lanes, not a cultural ranking. On this device they are scheduled serially in the declared lane order unless a future measured resource budget permits otherwise.
non_randomization_rule: Stage eligibility, prerequisite checks, source admission, lesson identifiers, and evaluation manifests are fixed. Generated practice may vary only through a declared reproducible enumerator; it must never choose a later concept before its prerequisites pass.
source_rule: Original-language works are catalog references, not downloaded training data. Preserve the source language, script, edition, and textual-history metadata. Do not normalize away meaningful distinctions, scrape hosts, or admit an extract until rights, provenance, cultural protocol, a verifier, and held-out tests have been reviewed.

implemented_now: generated quantities, addition, and subtraction with exact verifiers
current_implementation_boundary.honesty_rule: The ASCII prototype is a small bootstrap experiment. It is not evidence that Kavi reads Arabic, Bengali, Chinese, Devanagari, Hangul, Tamil, or any other writing system.

levels.title: Keep a symbol exactly itself
skills: reversible byte and Unicode scalar handling
explicit encoding and normalization metadata
direction, script, language, and edition as separate fields
abstention on unsupported or ambiguous input
levels.mastery_gate: Round-trip every supported test token exactly; preserve the original code points and record, rather than silently replace, any normalization choice.
levels.why_first: If the model cannot preserve a written signal faithfully, it cannot honestly learn from an original-language source.

levels.title: Recognize simple generated symbols
skills: lowercase ASCII letter kind
decimal digit kind
nearest verified prototype with abstention
levels.mastery_gate: Fixed protected and held-out generated glyph manifests reach the declared exact-accuracy floor without a regression.
levels.why_here: This is a tiny source-free test of verified pattern compression; it is deliberately not a language lesson.

levels.title: Tell writing systems apart before claiming to read them
skills: script identity
character class and direction metadata
script-specific glyph discrimination
explicit unsupported-script abstention
levels.mastery_gate: A generated, script-balanced manifest verifies identity and discrimination for every admitted script, including held-out glyphs and confusable characters.
levels.why_here: A script is not a language, but correct script handling is a prerequisite for all later language-specific pathways.

levels.title: Connect notation to exact quantity
skills: decimal place value
Arabic-Indic, Eastern Arabic-Indic, Devanagari, Bengali, Tamil, and Han numeral forms
Roman numerals as a non-positional comparison
equivalence between a verified notation and an exact quantity
levels.mastery_gate: Exact conversion and arithmetic checks on withheld forms; the model must report which notation rule it used and abstain when a notation is ambiguous or outside scope.
levels.why_here: Quantity is shared across languages, while its written forms are not. This keeps the concept separate from any one alphabet.

levels.title: Learn how each supported language forms meaningful units
skills: grapheme and word-boundary handling where the language uses them
joining and direction rules where relevant
morphology and inflection only within a reviewed language lane
clear separation between a written form, pronunciation aid, gloss, and meaning claim
levels.mastery_gate: Language-specific minimal-pair and held-out composition tests reviewed by qualified readers; no test may silently use an English-only proxy for the target language.
levels.why_here: The model should not force all languages into one English-shaped word model.

levels.title: Build checked meaning without replacing originals
skills: definitions, claims, examples, counterexamples, and uncertainty
approved gloss or translation alignment kept separate from original text
source-location citation and textual-variant awareness
formal or qualified-human verification of lesson claims
levels.mastery_gate: A source lesson passes provenance, rights, cultural review, concept prerequisite, external verifier, protected retention, and held-out transfer gates.
levels.why_here: Original works become evidence in their own languages, not decorative quotes or an unreviewed corpus.

levels.title: Study mathematics, science, logic, and research in dependency order
skills: formal proof and counterexample
measurement, units, uncertainty, and replication
source comparison across traditions and editions
rigorous research claims with an external checker
levels.mastery_gate: Domain-specific held-out evaluation and retained earlier-language abilities; an unverified answer never counts as a solved result.
levels.why_here: Advanced works depend on all earlier signal, language, quantity, and verification abilities.

script_and_language_lanes.special_handling: Do not infer that a shared Latin script means shared grammar, pronunciation, or meaning.
Treat historical and modern varieties as separate lesson scopes.
Require direction, joining, diacritic, and language metadata; Arabic script does not identify a single language.
Do not collapse an Indic script, a liturgical language, and a modern spoken language into one category.
Character identity, reading, and language are distinct tasks; do not use a modern pronunciation as if it were an original-text meaning.
Several knowledge traditions are oral, sacred, or community-governed. They require consent and a community protocol, not automated collection.

Indigenous data sovereignty and community authority are prerequisites for any source work. Oral knowledge, ceremonial material, and restricted material remain out of scope unless explicitly approved by the relevant community.
Add a lane only with a script-aware evaluator and qualified language review; coverage is intentionally expandable rather than pretending this first catalog covers every language.

admission_checklist: Exact source, creator or tradition, edition or manuscript witness, language, script, source URL, and applicable rights are recorded.
Any community, repository, or host-specific protocol is recorded and satisfied; a public web page is not blanket permission.
The local extract remains outside the public repository and has a fingerprint.
The lesson names one concept, its prerequisite nodes, an explanation scope, and an independent verifier.
Protected retention and held-out transfer tests are fixed before the candidate update is measured.
A failed or uncertain result remains a failure or abstention; it is not relabeled as mastery.
